messages:
Emma (Docs): Heads-up: we're rolling out SDK v5.0 next week and doing a docs/sample repo refresh. Breaking change: the `response_limit` param is renamed to `max_output_tokens` and its behavior is stricter (will truncate by default). Deprecation window: 90 days. See migration notes below.

Raj (SDK): ETA on the published migration guide? also will old clients error or warn?

Emma (Docs): migration guide is live in the preview docs now -> https://docs.redwood.inference/sdk/migrate-5 : included a compatibility shim but it only logs a warning, does not emulate old truncation semantics. We recommend apps switch to `max_output_tokens` ASAP.

Mike (Eng): Quick note: runtime will continue to accept `response_limit` for the 90-day window but with a warning header on responses and a deprecation metric emitted. No hard 400s until the cutoff.

Sara (Product): We'll add a banner in the Console and email teams with >=50k tokens/month usage. Planning a short webinar on migration (Wed, 11am PT).

Raj (SDK): thx. Can we include a tiny migration snippet for the most common patterns? saves tickets.

Emma (Docs): Yep, added snippet. Paste below for reference.

Emma (Docs): ```python
# old usage (v4.x)
resp = client.generate(prompt, response_limit=512)

# new usage (v5.0)
resp = client.generate(prompt, max_output_tokens=512)

# if you need old truncation behavior explicitly:
resp = client.generate(prompt, max_output_tokens=512, truncate_strategy='legacy')
```

Mike (Eng): Also note: default retry/backoff changed (fewer retries for 5xx to reduce downstream load). If you rely on automatic retries, opt back in via `client.config.retries = 3` in your bootstrap.

Raj (SDK): will update SDK samples and py/js libs to surface the rename + opt-in retry knob. PR incoming.

DeployBot: release-candidate build r5.0-rc3 created for internal testing at https://ci.redwood.build/r/5502 : smoke tests passing 18/20, two flaky cases tracked. :rocket:

Emma (Docs): Filing: consolidated checklist in the doc -> migration checklist, sample changes, API snippet, Console banner text, deprecation FAQ. Link: https://docs.redwood.inference/internal/migration-5-checklist (internal).

Sara (Product): tagging @eng-sales and @support for the email templates and upgrade playbook.

Raj (SDK): dev note: sdk changelog will call out explicit mapping of all renamed params and default behavior diffs. I'll include a small script to auto-apply the rename across codebases for easy migration.

Emma (Docs): thanks team. Action items: docs to finalize checklist (Emma), SDKs to publish v5.0-rc and samples (Raj), infra to monitor deprecation metrics (Mike), comms/webinar (Sara). I'll follow up with the timeline doc later today. :calendar:

Mike (Eng): putting observability alert on deprecation-warning-rate > 5% of requests for a customer -> paging policy discussed.

Emma (Docs): any objections to 90 days? last chance to speak up now.

Raj (SDK): 90 days works for us.

Sara (Product): +1

Emma (Docs): OK locked. publishing the public migration page tomorrow AM and scheduling the webinar. Thanks everyone! :tada:
